tasks.label: tmp-user-request-direction-string-update
args:
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/Volumes/TOSHIBA EXT/College Essay/src/lib/fm/direction.ts')
t=p.read_text()
reps=[
("return 'you realized your old standard failed and changed it';","return 'the moment you realized your old standard failed and changed it';"),
("return 'you saw the failure clearly and changed your method';","return 'the moment you saw the failure clearly and changed your method';"),
("return 'you noticed the mismatch and became different in practice';","return 'the moment you noticed the mismatch and became different in practice';"),
("return 'you decided reliability mattered more and changed your approach';","return 'the moment you decided reliability mattered more and changed your approach';"),
("return 'you realized intention was not enough and changed your response';","return 'the moment you realized intention was not enough and changed your response';"),
("return 'you decided responsibility was yours and acted on it';","return 'the moment you decided responsibility was yours and acted on it';"),
("return 'you saw the conflict differently and changed your lens';","return 'the moment you saw the conflict differently and changed your lens';"),
("return 'you noticed what had to change and made the harder call';","return 'the moment you noticed what had to change and made the harder call';"),
("return 'that decision proved the correction held under pressure';","return 'the first proof that the correction held under pressure';"),
("return 'that shift showed up when you rebuilt what came next';","return 'the first rebuilt step that showed the shift was real';"),
("return 'that change became visible in what you actually did';","return 'the first visible behavior that made the change concrete';"),
("return 'that choice showed you valued accountability over speed';","return 'the first choice that showed accountability mattered more than speed';"),
("return 'that response proved you adapted to real impact';","return 'the first response that proved you adapted to real impact';"),
("return 'that action showed responsibility had become your call';","return 'the first action that showed responsibility had become your call';"),
("return 'that response showed your new lens in action';","return 'the first response that showed your new lens in action';"),
("return 'that outcome showed the decision changed what happened next';","return 'the first outcome that showed the decision changed what happened next';"),
("`Center this essay on what ${turningQ} showed you about someone else’s need, and how you changed your response.`","`Center this essay on what you learned when ${turningQ}, and how you changed your response.`"),
("`This essay is about what ${turningQ} taught you about another person’s need, and the response you chose after that.`","`This essay is about what you learned when ${turningQ}, and the response you chose after that.`"),
("`Argue that what you believed about yourself collided with what ${turningQ} proved, and show the standard that replaced it.`","`Argue that what you believed about yourself collided with what happened when ${turningQ}, and show the standard that replaced it.`"),
]
changed=0
for old,new in reps:
    if old in t:
        t=t.replace(old,new)
        changed+=1
p.write_text(t)
print(changed)
